programme.title: Forensic Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In 1991, Grand Junction, Colorado is on edge after a series of deadly bombings kill two people and injure one more. Police race to find the culprit before he strikes again.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fresh Heir
programme.desc: Lives changed in the 20 years following an unsolved murder, and so did forensic science. In time, a high-powered microscope and DNA profiling revealed a clue no one had seen before.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ticker Tape
programme.desc: A lifelong resident of the tiny town of Lefroy, Tasmania was murdered outside his own home. Robbery appeared to be the motive, but with no suspects, the investigation came to a halt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Step by Step
programme.desc: When a wealthy socialite died after falling down the stairs, witness accounts contradicted evidence. To find out what really happened, investigators employed a physicist and an expert in accident reconstruction.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Blanket of Evidence
programme.desc: In 1997, Kelly Eckart's car was found, with her belongings still in it, after she worked a late shift in Franklin, Indiana. Days later, her body was found in an isolated ravine.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fired-Up
programme.desc: In 1996, Derrick Duehren returned to find his Oregon home burned to the ground. His wife's charred remains were later found in the rubble. Investigators set out to determine if it was an unfortunate accident or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Two in a Million
programme.desc: A millionaire and his family were executed in their own home. For three years, the murders went unsolved. Finally, a 30-year-old box of ammunition and some fluorescent fibers revealed the ultimate betrayal.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sharper Image
programme.desc: When a young girl was found dead, police quickly arrested the most likely suspect. But cutting-edge technology from NASA enabled a forensic odontologist to prove the wrong man was behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insulated Evidence
programme.desc: It's usually easy to determine how a criminal entered the crime scene. But in this case, it looked as if the killer vanished into thin air ? and perhaps he had.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Hearted
programme.desc: When a young fireman died from what appeared to be serious but undiagnosed heart disease, his family and friends had no proof of foul play.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Victim Zero
programme.desc: A brawl erupts at a local bar ends with the shooting death of a army solider. To unravel the murder, Lt. Joe Kenda most infiltrate a revered military institution, and expose a dangerous vendetta.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead Man Falling
programme.desc: When a family of four is brutally murdered, it sends a shockwave of fear through the town. Police believe they have a spree killer on their hands, until Lt. Joe Kenda discovers a gruesome connection.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My Case To Solve
programme.desc: A jealous vendetta leaves a popular DJ dead, and his killer has dropped off the map. Sgt Joe Kenda gambles his career on a risky strategy to bring his prime suspect to justice.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Fare
programme.desc: A young man is found dead behind the wheel of his taxi. With robbery seeming unlikely, Kenda and Gaenzle wonder if this was personal.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Gut Instinct
programme.desc: When a soon-to-be grandmother doesn’t come home from work and the investigation unfolds, Lt. Joe Kenda realizes they could be dealing with a fledgling serial killer.

programme.title: One Small Step: Neil Armstrong
programme.desc: Neil Armstrong has stamped his place in History by becoming the first person to walk on the moon.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms
programme.desc: Project Gemini: Docking and EVA - In the final phase of the Gemini program NASA struggles with docking and spacewalks. Curiosity Roving Mars - On the surface of Mars the Curiosity rover is changing the way we think about the red planet.

programme.title: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage
programme.desc: Interviews with Apollo 8 astronauts, their wives, mission control staff, and journalists give true insider's perspective to the space race of the late 1960's.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity keeps us on the ground and the planets in their orbits, yet we only notice it when it's not there. In space we cheat gravity; falling just as fast but missing the ground. Now this fundamental universal force is slowly giving up its secrets.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Planet Makers
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our solar system 4.5 billions years ago, there remain many clues to reveal its evolution. Remnant debris, asteroids, and comets are what's left of the building blocks to our celestial neighborhood.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Windows to Other Worlds / Fountain of Creation
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Virtual Universe
programme.desc: Our understanding of the cosmos is limited by the amount of time we have to see it. Fortunately, computer simulations can help us see how galaxies interact over millions of years, and even how dark matter structures the universe.

programme.title: iCarly: En rektor med karakter

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: En ellers lidt ordinær video EKSPLODEREDE på Tik Tok, da en mand der hjalp sagde nej til Pelles blomster med ordene ”Nej tak, jeg er til kvinder – helst!”. Vi taler om, hvad der har overrasket os i forhold til hvilke videoer der når langt ud.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvordan går det, når vi har allieret os med TV-værten Anders Breinholt? – det bliver lidt noget rod, og senere, så ender vi i et kæmpe dilemma, når der pludselig er flere, der springer til for at hjælpe – og vi har kun én præmie.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Pelle og René sætter ord på tilblivelsen af ”Den Gode Gerning”. Hør hvordan René nærmest ved et tilfælde bliver revet med i foretagendet, og så står de med en vild opdagelse efter, de har optaget de første videoer – det er kun de ”gamle” der hjælper!!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Den Gode Gerning” er skudt i gang, og som noget nyt hylder Pelle og René folk, der til dagligt gør en forskel for andre. Det bliver virkelig rørende, da de hjælper brystkræftramte Malene med at sige tak til hendes hjælpsomme veninde Michelle.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Igen tager drengene med deres kamera ud til skønne mennesker, der er noget for andre. Og i den nordjyske by Hals, falder de over en mand, der har en skøn historie fra sin tid som spejder – en historie, der til stadighed får ham til at gøre gode gerninger.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Der går nærmest hjælpemiddelcentral i den i de videoer, der med i dag – to ældre mennesker med rollatorer og Pelle i en rullestol. Det er med andre ord scenarier med folk, der virkelig har brug for hjælp og dermed ekstra rørende, når folk springer til.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Bedst som René og Pelle troede, at det at hjælpe i ”Den Gode Gerning” udelukkende var for ældre mennesker, så kommer de unge på banen. Dagens videoer er fulde af dejlige unge mennesker, der springer til og på skønneste vis giver håb for ungdommen.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 501
programme.desc: For første gang i Skønne ombygninger rejser fyrene til udlandet, nemlig ned til de franske vinstokke. Her renoverer de et charmerende sommerhus for et norsk par, i hjertet af Provence.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 502
programme.desc: I andet afsnit af sæsonen rejser vores renoveringsgenier til en hytte uden for den idylliske by Lillesand. Det bliver en uforglemmelig uge med et kreativt og overraskende resultat.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 503
programme.desc: Teamet har aldrig før haft at gøre med en uidentificerbar flyvende genstand, men én gang skal jo være den første. Hold på hat og briller, for deres projekt i Nevlunghavn bliver en udenjordisk oplevelse.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 504
programme.desc: Denne uge påbegynder teamet en renovering, som ejerne ikke har efterspurgt. De tilbringer seks dage ved Værøy fyr uden for Lofoten på en opgave, som ejerne tror vil tage fem til seks år.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 505
programme.desc: En gammel bjælkehytte på en ø midt i Nordmarka får en større opgradering og bliver tilpasset nye tider.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 8
programme.desc: Omdrejningspunktet for dagen er fisk, og hvem er bedre end Jakob Mielcke til give en masterclass i netop det. Herefter bliver de fire deltagere testet i en fri ret med makrel.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 9
programme.desc: Spændingen er høj, da et nyt hold deltagere indtager MasterChef-køkkenet. De håbefulde aspiranter dypper først tæerne i vandet med en vaskeægte klassiker – en wienersnitzel.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 10
programme.desc: Piskeriset kommer i den grad på overarbejde i dagens afsnit af MasterChef, hvor der er fuldt fokus på saucer. Deltagerne skal præsentere dommerne for deres favoritsauce.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 11
programme.desc: Gårsdagens tre vindere tørner sammen til en ‘vinderdag’, hvor deltagerne skal imponere dommerne i både det søde og det salte køkken, men hvordan undgår man, at det går i kage, når temaet er kartofler?

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 12
programme.desc: I en krydret episode af Masterchef bliver deltagerne udfordret i det indiske køkken. Med duften af eksotiske krydderier i luften kæmpes der om at imponere dommerne med autentiske retter.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1303
programme.desc: Der bliver budt på en rørende aften, når kendisfrisør Dennis Knudsen byder indenfor i sin luksusvilla i Korsør. Han lover mad på max 20 minutter - men mon det virkelig kan lade sig gøre uden hjælp?

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1304
programme.desc: Der er ikke mange ting tilbage på realitystjernen Vivi Bachs krop, der ikke har været forbi en kirurg , men kan Paradise-baben mon diske op med en menu med lige så meget kirurgisk præcision?

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1305
programme.desc: En forsamling af fire vidt forskellige personligheder mødes, når designeren Søren Le Schmidt skal imponere, men ikke alle ved bordet er lige diplomatiske, når de tilkendegiver deres holdninger.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1306
programme.desc: Det bliver en på mange måder grænseoverskridende aften, når filmproducenten Peter Aalbæk Jensen inviterer sine gæster til middag. En aften fyldt med overraskelser og uenigheder, de sent glemmer.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1307
programme.desc: Det er en højlydt oplevelse på alle måder, når aftenens vært, journalist og podcastvært Ditte Okman, byder indenfor, men det er ikke alle, der lader sig imponere af ekstravagant pynt og dyre råvarer.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1308
programme.desc: Det er ikke alt, der går helt som det skal, når hardliner politikeren, Mette Thiesen inviterer sine gæster på en overraskende menu. Heldigvis kan meget reddes med lidt vand.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 501
programme.desc: Louise og Jonas fra Viborg drømmer stort, men drømmen falder til jorden med et brag. Eksperterne kommer på ekstraarbejde, før det – forhåbentlig – ender med, at den lille familie flytter ind i drømmehuset.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 502
programme.desc: Anita og Martins to børn har overtaget hjemmet, og der er legetøj overalt. Løsningen er en større bolig, men det er ikke lykkedes parret at finde det rigtige hus. Nu går eksperterne i gang, men det bliver ikke nemt.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 503
programme.desc: Tina og Danni solgte deres rækkehus i troen på, at de nok hurtigt ville finde det rette hus. Men nej. Parret er superkræsne, og har høje krav. Kan eksperterne skabe det hjem, Tina og Danni drømmer om?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 504
programme.desc: Laura og Jesper og Jespers to børn bor til leje i Humlebæk, og det er de mildest talt trætte af. De mangler plads, have – og de vil også gerne have børn sammen snart. Men to års boligjagt har ikke givet bonus.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 605
programme.desc: Det danske genoptrænings-hospital Montebello ligger fantastisk smukt i Malagas højder. Desværre er der ikke noget smukt ved den mad, der serveres på stedet. Langt fra.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 606
programme.desc: Tunø er med sine blot 118 beboere og en sparsom færgeforbindelse til fastlandet en del af det udkantsdanmark, som kan være svært at holde liv i. Det vil Jan og Christina fra Thunø Kro gøre noget ved.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 701
programme.desc: Carsten driver restaurant Karin’s Hjemmelavede i Næstved. Men jobbet som restauratør, er dog noget uvant for den tidligere VVS’er, der ingen erfaring har på området.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 702
programme.desc: I Vejle er stemningen på nulpunktet. Heini og Marianas drøm om et argentinsk spisehus er begyndt at briste. Heini er nedlagt med sygdom, og Mariana kan ikke klare arbejdet i restauranten selv.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 703
programme.desc: Caféen i Aalborg kører slet ikke rundt. En forretning udelukkende baseret på billige deal-gæster, truer med at slå bunden ud af det unge forpagter-pars økonomi.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 704
programme.desc: På Da Carmine har de en vaskeægte napolitansk kok! Men problemet er bare, at han har mistet passionen for at lave ægte italiensk mad.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Awkward!
programme.desc: Vinny og Jionni løser deres problemer, så Vin og Nicole kan genoptage deres venskab, og Mike erkender sine fejl og prøver at blive gode venner med Nicole igen.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Raining Men & Meatballs
programme.desc: Kødbollerne overtager strandpromenaden og holder prøver for at finde en midlertidig festven til Deena. Og Mike afslører for bofællerne, at han har været stripper.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Icing on the Cake
programme.desc: Sommeren er snart slut og bofællerne gør sig klar til at tage en sidste afsked med Seaside.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Reunion
programme.desc: Vores yndlingsbofæller genforenes en sidste gang og ser tilbage på de 3 sidste år!

programme.title: Jersey Shore: After Hours 606
programme.desc: Deena taler om sin anholdelse, Jenni og Rogers forhold bliver gransket og Vinny åbner op om sin blotter.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: After Hours 608
programme.desc: Deena og Sam har et stort skænderi på sofaen, efter de ser provokerende optagelser fra denne sæson. Og Vinny fejrer sin beslutning om at leve i cølibat.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: After Hours 610
programme.desc: I en mandeaften på sofaen taler Ronnie om Mike og Paulas brud, om at score i the Shore, og hvorfor alle fyrene var så hårde ved Jionni.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: After Hours 611
programme.desc: I en sidste tur på sofaen prøver Mike og Nicole at begrave stridsøksen, Vinny slutter fred med Jionni og Deena accepterer at en kødbolle kan blive voksen.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Jersey Shore Blooper Special: Breakdowns, Boobs and Bronzer
programme.desc: De bedste fald, kiksere and modekatastrofer i Jersey Shores historie præsenteres direkte fra strandhuset i Seaside Heights, NJ.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Gruppen får en lektion i vredeshåndtering og Charlotte lukker alle de negative følelser ud, som hun har for Gaz. Sophie og Joel bliver stangstive på en bytur og gør resten af gruppen forlegne.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: James og Gary ryger i totterne på hinanden og sender chokbølger gennem huset, og Charlottes hjerte åbner sig for Gary, når hun tilbyder ham sin støtte. Og en hemmeligt singletur til Whitsundays ender katastrofalt.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Opholdet i Sydney er snart slut og singlerne vil have en vild aften på Whitsundays, mens parrene i huset er mistænksomme. Vicky og Fit Dan har en uendelig lang date og Scotty prøver at finde noget selskab.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Geordie-slænget er tilbage i Newcastle, hvor de hører hjemme, og ser frem til en sommer med fester, scoringer, opkast og vilde drukture. Men lige når de har fundet sig til rette i huset igen, kommer chokket: Den nye pige Marnie ankommer.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Geordie-slænget er tilbage, og der festes, scores og drikkes i Newcastle, men det gik i knas, efter den nye pige Marnie kom i huset og der opstod problemer. Hun blæser på, hvad folk synes, og kan ikke holde fingrene fra Scott.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Holly's Birthday
programme.desc: Hollys fylder 21 og Geordie-slænget fejrer dagen, som kun de kan - med fest i huset, druk, sex og ballade. Men en lille tragedie indtræffer også, som fører til en uventet begravelse på stranden.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6
programme.desc: Træningslejren er snart slut, og DCC-portrætterne står på banen. Træningslejr-aspiranterne og veteranerne er klar til deres nærbilleder, klædt i specialsyede DCC-dragter med perfekt hår og makeup.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7
programme.desc: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders-truppen 2010 bliver bekendtgjort i løbet af de næste to dage. Det siger sig selv, at det er en stressende tid for træningslejr-aspiranterne. Tiden er inde til at imponere.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: 34 nyankomne og veteraner møder op i dragten for at tage gruppebilledet. Men der sættes en dæmper på glædes dag, fordi Dallas Cowboy Cheerleaders direktør og koreograf endnu ikke har offentliggjort truppen 2010.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Prøverne begynder
programme.desc: Cowboys Stadium i Arlington, Texas huser igen optagelsesprøverne til Dallas Cowboys' cheerleadere. 500 kandidater, der drømmer om at komme på DCC-holdet i 2011-12, ankommer før solopgang til de første prøver.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: På banen
programme.desc: Det flotte Cowboys Stadium er stedet for DCC's sidste prøver. Spændingen er stor for de 69 nye piger, da de 18 DCC-veteraner slutter sig til kampen om de eftertragtede invitationer til træningslejren.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Træningslejren
programme.desc: DCC's træningslejr begynder i aften på Valley Ranch! Presset på de nye kandidater er tydeligt, mens de prøver at planlægge og skaffe sig nye boliger i Dallas.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Den berømte uniform
programme.desc: Der er gået to uger af træningslejren, og Kelli og Judy begynder at vælge de første fra. Ugens øvetimer er vigtige for alle pigerne, da de forventes at mestre den verdensberømte DCC-kickline og at gå i spagat.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 7
programme.desc: Registrar Doctor Ashleigh Trimble takes the next call from paramedics. 81-year-old Roy is being blue lighted in, after falling over and landing badly on one of his artificial hips.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 8
programme.desc: With an already busy department, Nurse Chloe Wesley answers the red emergency phone. A 23-month-old toddler is being rushed in with suspected sepsis, a life-threatening condition that attacks the internal organs.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 9
programme.desc: Registrar Doctor Rob Cornford heads straight to Resus to treat 58-year-old window-fitter Craig who’s been blue-lighted in. He was working on a ladder on the first floor of a house when he fell and was knocked unconscious.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 10
programme.desc: Sister Jane Hawksworth has clocked on for a night shift to find every bed in Barnsley Hospital is taken. To get the department moving again Sister Jane and the close-knit Casualty team will have to pull together.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 11
programme.desc: Sister Benita Wainwright is leading the team, a day that she describes as “Chaos. There are people everywhere. It’s hard going. But staff pull together and make sure patients are looked after.”

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 12
programme.desc: At Barnsley Casualty the team clock on to a backlog of patients waiting to be transferred to wards. With no beds across the entire hospital, Sister Jane Hawksworth is battling to prevent patients being on trolleys for the NHS maximum of 12 hours.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Caged Shepherd, Tinkling Terrier

programme.desc: A retriever mix, and wire hair fox terriers siblings, have turned into a combative pack. A Sharpei/Dobie mix drools excessively. Rottie mix Dexter travels to Los Angeles for a refresher course.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: ATF Dog
programme.desc: Gavin, a decorated K-9 explosive sniffing agent for the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives, is terrified of loud noises. Cesar uses some creative tactics to rehabilitate him.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: A Lack of Vision, Wound Up Rottie, Attack of the Peek-a-Poo
programme.desc: Cody, a blind Yorkshire terrier, is overly protective. Rottweiler Buffy has a dangerous obsession with the horses. Peek-a-Poo puppy Chloe, growls, snaps, and bites to get her way.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kraftløs - Anden del: Et nyt mærke

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Hearted
programme.desc: When a young fireman died from what appeared to be serious but undiagnosed heart disease, his family and friends had no proof of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wheel of Misfortune
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Quite a Spectacle
programme.desc: It was one of the most unusual cases in forensic history. Investigators had to find a way to solve a murder case using only a squashed tomato found at the crime scene and tiny, pinpoint reflections of light in a photograph.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Transaction Failed
programme.desc: When a dedicated, well-respected teacher disappeared, police had to determine if she'd gone on vacation without telling anyone or if she was the victim of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Day the Music Died
programme.desc: Seattle police had no suspects in the violent murder of grunge singer Mia Zapata. More than a decade passed before evidence collected by a prescient medical examiner could be used by forensic scientists to identify the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Survivor
programme.desc: A Michigan State University grad student disappeared and was presumed dead. With the help of a professor of geological sciences, police hoped to get the "dirt" on her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insignificant Others
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Catch 22
programme.desc: In 1996, 54-year-old Gayle Isleib was ambushed in her Manchester, Connecticut driveway and shot to death. Police had to determine whether obsessive love was the motive for her murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: The victim had been sexually assaulted and stabbed to death on the beach. A pair of men's tennis shoes was discovered near her body. Police were sure that if they found the man who fit the shoes, they would also find the man who committed the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Screen Pass
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl went missing from her Colorado home. The only evidence the kidnapper left behind was three fingerprints on a window screen.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Eyes of a Child

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: #1 Suspect

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 507

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 508

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 509

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 510

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 12

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 13

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 14

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 15

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 16
programme.desc: Deltagerne får frie hænder til at kreere lige præcis den ret, de drømmer om. Men dommerne har en overraskelse med i ærmet, som vil ryste deltagerne. Kan fordelen fra gårsdagens afsnit redde én person?

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 17

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Tanned Triangle

programme.title: Geordie Shore: It All Kicks Off
programme.desc: Husets mure i Geordie Shore ryster, da Charlotte og Holly ender i et kæmpestort skænderi med den nye pige Marnie på en natklub, og det går helt skævt.

programme.title: Geordie Shore

programme.title: Geordie Shore: So Much For Family Night

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Gaz's Birthday

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Central Jutland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Åland (Part 2)

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Tornedalen

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: North Jutland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: East Denmark

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Kristianstad

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Southwest Jutland

programme.desc: While Japanese cuisine tends to be tradition-bound, this challenger refuses to be bound by old rules. He respects the basics, but is always looking for new ways to expand.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Iron Chef Kobe is challenged by Franco Canzoniere. Who's cuisine will reign supreme?

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kraftløs - Anden del: Et nyt mærke
programme.desc: Da en skurk stjæler Faredrengens superkræfter og opdager hans hemmelige identitet, angribes Henrys hjem af bøller. Mens Henry og Ray kæmper for at beskytte Henrys familie, forsøger Jasper, Charlotte og Schwoz at få hans kraft tilbage.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kraftløs - Anden del: En ny helt
programme.desc: Schwoz arbejder på at fremstille en antivirus, som kan standse en ond plan, mens Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand bekæmper en skurk. Faredrengens heltemod sættes på den ultimative prøve, mens de kæmper for at redde verden.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Ridderbesøg
programme.desc: Da riddertroppens ærkefjende Ryker slippes fri i Swellview, tager faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand ham med til Burger-slottet kun for at blive narret til at tilslutte sig skurkens styrker.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Farlig som en brækket arm
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen brækker sin arm, må Henry og gruppen finde på en måde at holde hans hemmelighed sikker.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Det store fugletyveri
programme.desc: Pipers skolepapegøje, Otto, begynder at repetere 'Henry er Faredrengen'. Henry og Jasper må trække tiden, indtil Ray, Charlotte og Schwoz finder en løsning.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hele familien Bilsky
programme.desc: Henrys nerver kommer på prøve, da Piper inviterer sin nye kæreste og hans familie til middag.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hemmeligt rum
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand afslører et rum reserveret til superhelte i mandehulen. Charlotte, Jasper og Schwoz laver i jalousi et endnu sejere rum. I kampen om hvem der har det sejeste rum, bliver tingene blæst helt ud af proportioner.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Min middag med Bigfoot
programme.desc: Da slænget bliver venner med Bigfoot i skoven, forsøger Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand at slippe af med irriterende jæger, som har forsøgt at fange Bigfoot.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Charlotte spøger
programme.desc: Schwoz opfinder en støvsuger til at hjælpe Henry med rengøring, men ved et uheld suges Charlotte ind i den. Henrys familie hører Charlotte og tror, at støvsugeren er hjemsøgt. Ray må distrahere dem, mens Henry finder en måde at få hende ud.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jeg drømmer om fare
programme.desc: Da Charlotte har en drøm, hvor hun næsten kysser Faredrengen, undgår hun efterfølgende Henry af frygt for, at drømmen bliver til virkelighed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Screen Pass
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl went missing from her Colorado home. The only evidence the kidnapper left behind was three fingerprints on a window screen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pressed for Crime
programme.desc: Several suspects and conflicting evidence complicated a brutal murder investigation. But the forensics were clear on one thing: the killer knew his victim, and that alone gave investigators a head start.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Finger Pane
programme.desc: A serial killer was on the loose and police had to find him before he struck again. Their most promising lead was an unusual one: a bloody fingerprint on the body of one of the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Good as Gold
programme.desc: On Halloween night 2004, Adriane Insogna and Leslie Mazzara were brutally murdered in their Napa, California home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freedom Fighter
programme.desc: After the suspect was convicted of arson and murder, he maintained his innocence. He turned to law books in the prison library and set out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Innocence
programme.desc: This killer probably hoped to cover his tracks by staging the crime scene. But investigators saw through the attempt almost immediately and turned to forensic science to learn what really happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Butt Certain
programme.desc: A 6-year-old girl ran and hid when she saw her grandmother being beaten to death, but the man followed, beat and assaulted her. She said the assailant was her uncle, who was later convicted. She recanted her testimony years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Jean Pool
programme.desc: In 1984, the body of college student Laura Salmon was found on a Middle Tennessee farm, covered with her own denim jeans as well as the jeans of the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traffic Violations
programme.desc: The body of a young woman was found a mile from her abandoned car. Police were especially concerned when they realized the victim had come to them for protection just two weeks earlier after a road rage incident.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Collective Justice
programme.desc: Philadelphia's Vidocq Society, named after an 18th Century French detective, is one of the world's most unusual crime-solving organizations.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Where is Claudia Jane
programme.desc: 15-year old CJ Bates is reported missing, and Kenda must investigate the mysterious circumstances behind the disappearance of the teenager.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Manifesto
programme.desc: A cabin on the slopes of Pikes Peak catches fire, and a young sheriff’s deputy is posted to guard the scene overnight--then he’s found dead in his patrol car the next morning.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My, My, Merry Christmas
programme.desc: Donald Ott is found shot to death, friends tell police he didn’t have an enemy in the world. But when Lt. Joe Kenda speaks with family, he learns of a relative who might hold the key to the mystery.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood Red Highway
programme.desc: The elderly owners of a local grocery are attacked and left for dead. Working with a vague witness description, Lt. Joe Kenda leads a state-wide manhunt to catch a pair of cold-blooded killers.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Sacrificial Lamb
programme.desc: When 13yr old PJ Grant is found dead from a single gunshot wound to the head, Kenda assumes it’s a suicide. When the physical evidence doesn’t add up, it opens the door to a world of possibilities.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living Planet
programme.desc: We have been observing Earth for 40 years now, in the last 20 we have focus with intensity on the planet with new technologies and capabilities, we have accumulated a mass of data that is now revealing a complex and ever changing living planet.

programme.title: The Apollo Experience: Apollo 17: Part 2
programme.desc: In this episode, hear first hand testimonials and dialogue from the incredible men who walked on the moon. Incredible footage and photos give a unique and beautiful experience of their data collection process and journey home.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Beyond Earth Orbit, IXV Vehicles & Galileo Satellites Lost and Found
programme.desc: Beyond Earth Orbit - The Apollo program takes bold new steps. IXV Re-entry Vehicle - Europe is working to perfect a re-entry vehicle. Galileo Satellites Lost and Found - Navigation satellites go into incorrect orbit.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Cosmic Collisions
programme.desc: Space is vast, yet it is full of collisions. Gas and dust electrostatically flock together, and gravity takes over coalescing grains into rocks. Those rocks become boulders, then asteroids colliding again and again, striking planets and each other.

programme.title: The Truth is in the Stars
programme.desc: Does our society have the capacity to live up to Star Trek's optimistic vision for humanity's future? William Shatner takes us on a journey to find out whether art has imitated life in the years since the world-renowned TV series premiered in 1966.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne Redder Vuf-og-roll-showet / Vovserne Redder en ørn
programme.desc: En storm blæser scenen i stykker inden en stor koncert. Kan Paw Patrol redde dagen? // Vovserne redder en ørn, der sidder fast i sin egen rede.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne og Piratskatten
programme.desc: Kaptajn Pighvar falder tilfældigt i en hemmelig hule, der engang var gemmested for en sørøver. Da Paw Patrol redder ham, finder de et ufuldstændigt skattekort.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne Redder Julen
programme.desc: Julemandens kane er strandet og rensdyrene stukket af. Ryder og Paw Patrol må hjælpe julemanden med at aflevere gaverne og redde julen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne Redder Hundekiks / Vovserne får et Lift
programme.desc: Paw Patrol skal bringe Hr. Porters lastbil med hundekiks i sikkerhed, da den er strandet på isen. // Paw Patrol må redde Katie og Cali, da skiliften på bjerget har sat sig fast.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne Redder en Flagermus / Vovserne Redder en "Fand"
programme.desc: En flagermus er faldet i søvn i rådhustårnet og Paw Patrol må hjælpe med at få den i sikkerhed. // For at kurere Alex´s tandlægeskræk, fortæller Paw Patrol-medlemmerne hver især, hvad der gør dem bange.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vov-vov-gæs / Vov, Vov og af Sted
programme.desc: Marshal får en ny ven i Dunet. Paw Patrol må hjælpe Dunet med at trække sydpå, da han ikke vil forlade Ryder. // Paw Patrol må hjælpe borgmesteren, der er kommet til at stige ombord i en varmluftsballon.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne Redder Badedagen / Cirkushundekunster
programme.desc: Da vovserne vil bade i pølen er den tom, så Paw Patrol må sørge for at der igen bliver vand i den // Da dyrene ikke er nået frem til cirkusforestillingens begyndelse, må Ryder og Paw Patrol træde til og hjælpe cirkusdirektøren.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne Møder Rubble / Vovserne Redder en Hvalros
programme.desc: Vi genser hvordan Rubble blev medlem af Paw Patrol ved at redde Jake fra et sneskred. // Hvalrossen Wally bliver fanget i et fiskenet under vandet. Ryder og Paw Patrol skal arbejde sammen for at få ham op til overfladen og ind til kysten i sikkerhed.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne går Bananas / Ugler i Bugten
programme.desc: Paw Patrol skal hjælpe med at fange en abe, der er sluppet løs fra sit bur, og jagten fører dem gennem hele byen. // Ryder og Paw Patrol opdager en ugleunge og hjælper den med at finde sin mor igen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne Redder Bugten / Vovserne Redder Godglad
programme.desc: Ryder og Paw Patrol må hjælpe til, da der sker et oliespild i Adventure Bay, så dyrelivet reddes. // Da statuen af byens grundlægger ender på havets bund, må Paw Patrol hjælpe borgmester Godglad med at få den i land igen.

programme.title: iCarly: iSælger penny-t-shirts
programme.desc: Vennerne kaster sig ud i at lave og sælge Penny-T-shits. Da salget går amok, hyrer Sam børn fra 4. til at hjælpe med at lave T-shirts. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie er uenige om, hvordan de skal behandles.

programme.title: iCarly: iLaver drengestreger
programme.desc: Da de andre driller Carly med, at hun aldrig har lavet fis, beder hun Spencer om hjælp med at lave fis med Sam og Freddie. Men da Spencer får smag for det, kan han ikke stoppe igen. Vennerne må finde en måde at stoppe ham på.

programme.title: iCarly: iSams mor
programme.desc: Efter et skænderi med sin mor flytter Sam ind hos Carly, som snart indser, at hun er en forfærdelig gæst. Freddie forfølges af en farlig forbryder, da han har fanget ham på fersk gerning på video.

programme.title: iCarly: iSkam på Nevel
programme.desc: Da en video af Nevel, der råber ad en lille pige, dukker op på nettet, begynder alle at hade ham. Efter de har fejret Nevels fald, går iCarly-vennerne i gang med at genoprette hans ære, da han tigger om deres hjælp.

programme.title: iCarly: iHyre en idiot
programme.desc: Vennerne beslutter at hyre en praktikant til webshowet. Carly og Sam hyrer en fyr, de synes er lækker, men han viser sig mest at være til besvær. Freddie må overbevise Carly og Sam om, at de skal af med ham.

programme.title: iCarly: iOMG
programme.desc: Vennerne bruger natten på at afslutte deres projekter på Ridgeway til den årlige nat på skolen. Carly og Freddie får mistanke om, at Sam måske er vild med deres nye ven Brad.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly møder Victorious
programme.desc: Carly mistænker, at hendes nye fyr, Steven, er utro med Tori Vega, så slænget planlægger en tur til Los Angeles for at afsløre ham til en fest, som Andre holder i Kenan Thompsons hus.

programme.title: iCarly: Datehjælpen
programme.desc: Carly træder til for at løse et skænderi mellem Sam og Freddie. Snart kommer Freddie og Sam til Carly for at få hjælp med hvert eneste skænderi. Nu hvor hun er involveret, hvordan kan Carly så trække sig?

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Den Gode Gerning” er skudt i gang, og som noget nyt hylder Pelle og René folk, der til dagligt gør en forskel for andre. Det bliver virkelig rørende, da de hjælper brystkræftramte Malene med at sige tak til hendes hjælpsomme veninde Michelle.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Igen tager drengene med deres kamera ud til skønne mennesker, der er noget for andre. Og i den nordjyske by Hals, falder de over en mand, der har en skøn historie fra sin tid som spejder – en historie, der til stadighed får ham til at gøre gode gerninger.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Der går nærmest hjælpemiddelcentral i den i de videoer, der med i dag – to ældre mennesker med rollatorer og Pelle i en rullestol. Det er med andre ord scenarier med folk, der virkelig har brug for hjælp og dermed ekstra rørende, når folk springer til.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Bedst som René og Pelle troede, at det at hjælpe i ”Den Gode Gerning” udelukkende var for ældre mennesker, så kommer de unge på banen. Dagens videoer er fulde af dejlige unge mennesker, der springer til og på skønneste vis giver håb for ungdommen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Udenom og sågar henover – sådan foregår det, når folk skal passere det løbehjul, som vi har lagt på gaden midt i Århus. Det skaber stor forargelse skaber vores første virale hit. Se også hvordan det går, når vi gentager eksperimentet i Odense.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi fortæller om, hvordan det er, når vi skal finde en kvinde på gaden, som vi kan gøre gravid. Det er en vild, sjov og skør opgave. Vi har også en medvirkende, der virkelig er presset over hendes opgave og så én, der ikke fatter, hvad der ramte ham.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: En ellers lidt ordinær video EKSPLODEREDE på Tik Tok, da en mand der hjalp sagde nej til Pelles blomster med ordene ”Nej tak, jeg er til kvinder – helst!”. Vi taler om, hvad der har overrasket os i forhold til hvilke videoer der når langt ud.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvad gør folk, hvis de får valget mellem at beholde en stor gave selv og give en lille en videre – eller omvendt!? Det ser vi på i de her videoer, hvor vi netop leger med at give dem, der hjælper, den mulighed. Det er overraskende, hvad der sker.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvordan går det, når vi har allieret os med TV-værten Anders Breinholt? – det bliver lidt noget rod, og senere, så ender vi i et kæmpe dilemma, når der pludselig er flere, der springer til for at hjælpe – og vi har kun én præmie.

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Fyn

programme.title: Henry Danger: Synlige Brad

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traffic Violations
programme.desc: The body of a young woman was found a mile from her abandoned car. Police were especially concerned when they realized the victim had come to them for protection just two weeks earlier after a road rage incident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In 1969, 25-year-old phone operator Diane Maxwell was raped and murdered. Her brother promised he'd find out who was responsible and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Disrobed
programme.desc: The crime scene was especially violent: a husband and wife had been shot to death in their bedroom. Was their 16-year-old daughter complicit?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Driven to Silence
programme.desc: A young hairdresser was sexually assaulted and murdered in her own beauty salon. The evidence at the crime scene didn't match any of the suspects and, after the initial investigation, the case went cold for ten years.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Printed Proof
programme.desc: When two women went missing and were later found brutally murdered, police wondered if they were victims of a hate crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: About Face
programme.desc: A human skeleton was discovered in the North Carolina marshlands. When investigators learned she'd been dead for 18 months, they knew it would be difficult to find out who she was, let alone who killed her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In the Bag
programme.desc: After shooting his victims in the head, the killer staged the scene, placed the incriminating evidence into a plastic bag and tossed it into the river.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Yes, In Deed
programme.desc: It was a tragic twist of fate. Just days after a woman sold her home and moved to a modest trailer, a fire took both the trailer and her life. But the autopsy proved this was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Guarded Secrets
programme.desc: A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace; his remains were found a year later in a remote campsite.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder
programme.desc: There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison. When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Sacrificial Lamb
programme.desc: When 13yr old PJ Grant is found dead from a single gunshot wound to the head, Kenda assumes it’s a suicide. When the physical evidence doesn’t add up, it opens the door to a world of possibilities.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: To The Death
programme.desc: When two young men are found shot in an apartment hallway, Kenda must rely on his inner lie detector to figure out which victim was no victim at all.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Cage
programme.desc: Kenda finds the bullet-ridden bodies of a middle-aged couple in a musty suburban house alongside the corpses of their two beloved pets.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Officer Down
programme.desc: Sgt. Joe Kenda is faced with his worst nightmare when he learns a friend and fellow officer, Mark Dabling, has been killed in the line of duty.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Make My Day
programme.desc: When Keith Andrews is killed, a man steps forward claiming he did it in self-defense—but Lt. Joe Kenda has his doubts.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: When the Music Stops
programme.desc: Vietnam War veteran Charles Walker is found unconscious, after a stabbing attack so savage even 45 units of blood couldn’t save his life.

programme.title: The Truth is in the Stars
programme.desc: Does our society have the capacity to live up to Star Trek's optimistic vision for humanity's future? William Shatner takes us on a journey to find out whether art has imitated life in the years since the world-renowned TV series premiered in 1966.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gravity
programme.desc: This film features unexpected historical insights, cutting-edge science and exciting new experiments. From Einstein's Relativity to quantum mechanics, host Jim Al-Khalili explores one of the most extraordinary phenomena in our universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Borderland / Mars: Red Dawn
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Shooting Gallery: Asteroids and Comets / Galactic Visions: Alien Worlds
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: To The Moon, SpaceX's Dragon and Falcon & GAIA
programme.desc: To the Moon - The Apollo program achieves its major objective. Dragon, Falcon and Spacex - New directions in re-usable spacecraft. Gaia- Mapping our galaxy in unprecedented detail.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury Advancement, Camera Tracking & The International Space Station
programme.desc: Project Mercury Advances - America's first manned space program finally puts a man in orbit. Camera Tracking - The array of special cameras that follow a spacecraft at launch. The International Space Station - The building and operation.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Dark Side
programme.desc: In terms of the Universe, we know we don't know much, especially when it comes to dark matter and dark energy. Scientists are devoting so much of their time to discovering as much as the possibly can about this mysterious matter.

programme.desc: Paw Patrol leger på stranden og opdager havskildpaddeæg! Skildpadderne kan ikke krydse vejen og nå ud i havet, så Paw Patrol må hjælpe dem. // En hvalunge er strandet i Adventure Bay. Paw Patrol hjælper ungen med at finde tilbage til sin mor.

programme.title: iCarly: Datehjælpen

programme.title: iCarly: Nærmest uudholdeligt
programme.desc: Mrs. Benson opdager Sam og Freddies forhold efter Gibby, som Sam nu håner, og planlægger at skille dem ad. Vil Carly kæmpe for Sam og Freddie, eller hjælpe Gibby med at skille dem ad?

programme.title: iCarly: Fuld af kærlighed
programme.desc: Carly siger, at Sam og Freddie skal prøve hinandens yndlingshobbier. Imens møder Spencer en gammel barnepige og inviterer hende ud på middag. Men bliver de sammen, efter de falder tilbage i deres gamle roller?

programme.title: iCarly: iQ
programme.desc: Carly vil imponere en ny fyr ved at prøve at se smartere ud, end hun er. Og slænget prøver at finde et nyt sted at bo til T-Bo, efter han bliver smidt ud af Groovy Smoothie.

programme.title: iCarly: Førstedamen
programme.desc: Et føderalt bureau begynder at undersøge iCarly-slænget, efter de hacker ind i et sikkert netværk for at holde netfødselsdag for Carlys far. *Gæstestjerne - Michelle Obama.

programme.title: iCarly: Fedtekage-tyv
programme.desc: Slænget, minus Carly, tager Sam med til Canadian Fat Cake-fabrikken, men så kan Sam ikke komme ind i Amerika igen. Imens har Carly problemer i badet, mens hun gør sig klar til en date.

programme.title: iCarly: En øjenåbner
